t.t-out: 'PO to Approve' if req.state == 'sent' else ('Cancelled' if req.state in ('rejected', 'cancel') else ('Delivered' if (req.state == 'done' or (req.approved_total > 0 and req.delivered_total >= req.approved_total - 0.01)) else ('Out for Delivery' if (req.delivered_total > 0 or any(d.delivery_ids for d in req.demand_ids)) else 'PO to Deliver')))

div.div: Ordered . We deliver and invoice this order; you can follow it here.

span.t-attf-class: pill #{'p-bad' if order.state == 'cancel' or getattr(order, 'distributor_status', False) == 'rejected' else ('p-good' if order.invoice_status == 'invoiced' else ('p-good' if getattr(order, 'delivery_status', False) == 'full' else ('p-warn' if (getattr(order, 'distributor_status', False) == 'pending' or order.state in ('draft', 'sent')) else 'p-info')))}

t.t-out: 'Cancelled' if order.state == 'cancel' or getattr(order, 'distributor_status', False) == 'rejected' else ('Invoiced' if order.invoice_status == 'invoiced' else ('Delivered' if getattr(order, 'delivery_status', False) == 'full' else ('To Approve' if (getattr(order, 'distributor_status', False) == 'pending' or order.state in ('draft', 'sent')) else 'Approved')))

div.div: Not invoiced yet. We invoice after delivery.

pill #{'p-good' if note.state == 'approved' else ('p-bad' if note.state == 'rejected' else 'p-warn')}

pill #{'p-good' if move.payment_state in ('paid', 'in_payment') else ('p-warn' if move.payment_state == 'partial' else 'p-bad')}
